description.value: A 172-seat community theatre operated by Nanaimo Theatre Group, celebrating over 65 years of live performances. The intimate, air-conditioned venue hosts a varied season of plays and hosts regional drama festivals. A touring cyclist spending an evening in Nanaimo could catch a community theatre production in a well-maintained, wheelchair-accessible space with a lounge area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Bailey Studio, a 172-seat community theatre operated by Nanaimo Theatre Group at 2373 Rosstown Road. The About page states 'Free parking is available in our well-lit lot' (car parking only, no bike parking mentioned), 'All areas are wheelchair accessible' (implies washrooms exist and are accessible), and 'Refreshments can be enjoyed in our lounge.' No cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site. The OSM address matches the website exactly; phone numbers appear on the website but not in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; website lists two numbers (tickets: 250-758-7224, general: 250-758-7246)
Free parking mentioned is a car lot; no bike-specific parking mentioned
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active community theatre with 65+ years of history, a legitimate cultural attraction for touring cyclists spending time in Nanaimo. Has washrooms, refreshments, free parking, and wheelchair accessibility.
enrichment_extras.notes: Hearing assistance (infra-red units) available upon request. The venue also hosts regional drama festivals.

Café or food on site.detail: Refreshments can be enjoyed in our lounge (theatre lounge, available during performances)

wow_evidence: 172-seat community theatre, 65+ years of productions; show-conditional.
blurb: Nanaimo Theatre Group's 172-seat Bailey Studio; catch a show if one's on.
